reproduction.expected: A user can initialize and verify a coherent customer-agent Harness package containing project configuration, domain Skills, audit/architecture/repair/full-development Workflows, extension overlays, and provider bindings without hand-writing every YAML file.
reproduction.actual: Authoring and Composition operate on individual declarations only; no starter manifest, package verifier, bundled customer-agent declarations, or starter-init command exists.

violated_invariants: Users should not need to hand-author a large set of YAML files to begin a supported project type.
A starter must compile through the same Authoring and Composition authorities used by manually authored declarations.
The generated customer application must remain standalone and must not import Harness runtime code.
